meta.title: Crise en cascade : typhon à Taïwan, grève à Rotterdam, flambée du fret
meta.notice: Scénario FICTIF écrit pour la démonstration. Ni les articles, ni les mesures, ni les entreprises ne sont réels.

storyline.1: Signal faible : un typhon se renforce, la prévision annonce des rafales à Kaohsiung dans 2 jours.
storyline.2: Le port de Kaohsiung annonce sa fermeture ; la prévision s'aggrave.
storyline.3: Le typhon touche terre : port fermé, usine de puces de Tainan inondée.
storyline.4: Congestion à Kaohsiung ; préavis de grève à Rotterdam ; le fret commence à monter.
storyline.5: Grève à Rotterdam : les deux bouts de la route des puces sont bloqués ; le fret s'envole.
storyline.6: Premier client touché : l'usine de calculateurs de Stuttgart réduit sa production.
storyline.7: L'usine d'assemblage de Valenciennes s'arrête une semaine.

media.title: Typhoon Meilin strengthens over the Philippine Sea, forecasters warn southern Taiwan
media.text: Forecasters upgraded Typhoon Meilin to a severe storm on Monday. The typhoon is expected to approach Taiwan by Wednesday. Shipping lines say they are reviewing their schedules.

media.title: Port of Kaohsiung to suspend vessel operations ahead of Typhoon Meilin
media.text: Kaohsiung, 15 September. The Port of Kaohsiung announced a port closure from Tuesday evening as Typhoon Meilin approaches. Container ship departures are cancelled and carriers warn of port congestion once operations resume.

media.title: Typhon Meilin : fermeture du port de Kaohsiung, les navires déroutés
media.text: Le port de Kaohsiung ferme ses terminaux à partir de mardi soir à l'approche du typhon Meilin. Plusieurs porte-conteneurs sont déroutés et les armateurs annoncent des retards.

media.title: Typhoon Meilin makes landfall near Kaohsiung, flooding industrial zones
media.text: Typhoon Meilin made landfall on Wednesday near Kaohsiung with violent gusts and torrential rain. Severe floods submerged industrial parks across southern Taiwan and factories suspended operations.

media.title: Formoz Power Semi halts production at Tainan fab after typhoon flooding
media.text: Tainan, 16 September. Chipmaker Formoz Power Semi halted production at its Tainan fab after flood water from Typhoon Meilin reached the site. The company could not say when output would resume.

media.title: Typhoon flooding: Formoz Power Semi halts production at its Tainan chip fab
media.text: Formoz Power Semi has stopped its production lines in Tainan because of typhoon flooding, the company said.

media.title: Kaohsiung port congestion builds as terminals reopen slowly after typhoon
media.text: Kaohsiung, 17 September. Port congestion is building at the Port of Kaohsiung, where damaged cranes keep several berths closed. Dozens of container ship calls are delayed and cargo is piling up on the quays.

media.title: Novalys unveils refreshed E-Trail electric SUV at motor show
media.text: The carmaker presented a new version of its electric SUV with a longer range and a redesigned interior.

media.title: Rotterdam dockworkers union calls 72-hour strike from Friday over automation plan
media.text: Rotterdam, 17 September. Dockworkers at the Port of Rotterdam voted for a 72-hour strike starting on Friday after talks over terminal automation failed. Unions expect container handling to stop.

media.title: Strike halts container handling at Port of Rotterdam terminals
media.text: Rotterdam, 18 September. Dockworkers began a 72-hour strike on Friday at the Port of Rotterdam. Port workers walked off the job at the main container terminals and cargo handling has stopped.

media.title: Grève au port de Rotterdam : les terminaux à l'arrêt
media.text: Les dockers du port de Rotterdam ont entamé vendredi une grève de 72 heures. La manutention des conteneurs est à l'arrêt et les chargeurs redoutent des retards de livraison.

media.title: Rhein Power Modules warns of power-chip shortage, cuts output at Stuttgart plant
media.text: Stuttgart, 19 September. Rhein Power Modules said a chip shortage forces it to cut output at its Stuttgart plant. Deliveries from Formoz Power Semi have stopped since the typhoon and stocks are running low.

media.title: Chip shortage: Novalys Valenciennes halts production of the E-City line for a week
media.text: Valenciennes, 20 September. The Novalys Valenciennes plant halts production of its E-City line for one week because of a shortage of power modules. The carmaker blames missing components from its supplier.

media.title: Pénurie de puces : l'usine Novalys Valenciennes à l'arrêt pendant une semaine
media.text: Faute de calculateurs, l'usine Novalys Valenciennes annonce un arrêt de production d'une semaine sur la ligne E-City. La pénurie de composants touche toute la filière.
